rows.Origin:
Bred by Colin Dickson (1956-....) (United Kingdom, before 2007).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Dickson Nurseries Ltd. / Dickson Roses in 2008 as 'Isn't She Lovely'.
rows.Bloom: Cream, gold center, deep pink center. Moderate fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Short, bushy, upright. Medium, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: up to 32" (up to 80cm).
rows.Parentage:

Glorious (hybrid tea, Ilsink, 2001)
